description: This file defines the class EachPromise, which manages multiple promises by iterating over an iterable of promises, handling their fulfillment or rejection, with support for concurrency control. It is part of the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, indicating it is related to promise handling in Guzzle HTTP client.

classes.name: EachPromise
classes.description: A class that manages the iteration and concurrent execution of multiple promises, invoking callback functions upon fulfillment or rejection, with configurable concurrency limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EachPromise instance with an iterable of promises/values and configuration options including concurrency, fulfillment, and rejection callbacks.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the aggregate promise which resolves when all individual promises are settled, initiating the promise creation and processing.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Creates the main aggregate promise for this EachPromise instance and sets up the internal resolution logic.

methods.name: refillPending
methods.description: Fills the pending promise list based on the specified concurrency limit, adding promises from the iterable.

methods.name: addPending
methods.description: Adds a new promise to the pending list, attaching fulfillment and rejection handlers.

methods.name: advanceIterator
methods.description: Advances the internal iterator safely, respecting mutex locks to prevent generator errors.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the completion of a promise at a specific index, removing it from pending and refilling if appropriate.

methods.name: checkIfFinished
methods.description: Checks whether all promises have been settled and resolves the aggregate promise accordingly.
